description: The destinations that fit one traveller, in the order of the site's ranking, each with its lodging figure, totality and sky, the entry regime of their passport, and the fares we have read from their airport to it. The fares and the stay are given side by side, never summed: they are different searches, read on different days. A place with no fare read from that airport is kept, with a note: that is a gap in our readings, not a claim that no flight exists.

country.description: Keep one country, by English name or ISO code, whatever the case: Egypt, Gibraltar, Morocco, Saudi Arabia, Spain, Tunisia.

max_price_per_person_eur.description: Keep places whose four-night stay costs at most this per person, in EUR.

min_totality_seconds.description: Keep places with at least this much totality, in seconds.

open_to_all_visitors.description: true leaves out places whose entry is restricted (Mecca, closed to non-Muslims).

origin.description: IATA code of the departure airport, e.g. MAD.

passport.description: ISO code of the traveller's passport: each place then carries that passport's entry regime.

name: plan_trip
title: Where one traveller can go, from their airport and passport
